counterplay.answer: Plus-frame routes into DGF, throws, Kincho mixups, unblockables in oki; keepout forces them to approach
counterplay.whatItBeats: His weak opening tools; he relies on counter hits and whiff punishes

counterplay.answer: Homing moves: f+3, uf+4, DGF.f+2, DGF.f+1+2, IND.3+4, KIN.4, KIN.f+2, hFC.df+4, 1+3, 2+4; f+1+2 tracks well
Learn those moves per matchup; block and punish instead
counterplay.whatTheyDo: Lab moves Flash cannot hit (TekkenDocs cites Lili's df+3+4)

counterplay.answer: Spin less, and only against linear strings
Mix the mid follow-ups: 3,2,1+2, b+2,1, df+1,2,1
Frame-trap with DGF.f+1+2 and DGF.2; vary entering DGF and not entering it
Mix KIN.2 alone, the held version, and throws
It only has a real mid mixup after the NSS frog jump
Use the unblockable or stand options; sometimes skip KIN
Use them as reads, not habits

plans.risks: Whiffed keepout pokes get launched; predictable pokes get sidestepped.
plans.title: Keepout
plans.when: Against opponents who walk you down; when you have the life lead and space behind you.

plans.risks: Forcing punishes on unpunishable moves; dropping the BnB after the punish.
plans.title: Punish into oki
plans.when: The default game plan: block, punish, convert the knockdown.

plans.risks: Wasted Heat on a blocked engager; Heat combos dropped under pressure.
plans.title: Heat
plans.when: When Heat is available and you need damage or a momentum swing; engage on hit, not on a guess.

plans.risks: Rage Art on a read that never comes; both tools are heavily punishable on block.
plans.title: Comeback (Rage Art and Heat Smash)
plans.when: Low health, one read away: Rage Art punishes a committed option; Heat Smash closes rounds.

plans.risks: Throws get broken; DGF entries get jabbed out.
plans.title: Anti-turtle
plans.when: Against patient blockers who will not press into your counter hits.

plans.risks: Flash loses to the moves it cannot hit; Spin loses to homing moves and throws.
plans.title: Anti-aggression (Flash, Spin, Kincho parry)
plans.when: Against relentless pressure: Flash interrupts gaps, Spin escapes linear strings, Kincho parry turns mids around.
